title: Snowbird Summer Excursion
blurb: Escape the city on our Snowbird Summer Excursion! Enjoy a scenic drive to Snowbird, followed by a thrilling tram ride to the mountain's peak. Savor lunch at Utah's highest restaurant with breathtaking views before embarking on a guided hike down the Cirque Trail. Expert guides provide tips for this high-altitude adventure. Round-trip transportation is included. Enjoy a more personal experience with our small-group tour (minimum of 2 guests required). Perfect for nature lovers seeking a day of adventure and relaxation. This is a 6-hour tour, including the drive from Salt Lake City to Snowbird, then back to Salt Lake City.
